Bay Area Hindi & Indian Wedding DJ Services

Contact DJ Chris: Call or Text: 1‑800‑568‑0443

World-Class Hindi & Indian Wedding DJ

Serving the San Francisco Bay Area, including San Francisco, San Ramon, Fremont, Palo AltoSunnyvale, San Jose, Berkeley, and beyond, DJ Jayan is your top choice for:

  • Bollywood & Bhangra music featuring classic favorites, high-energy remixes, and timeless romantic tunes
  • Sangeet, Diwali, and private events with energetic dance floors, intelligent lighting, and stage sound enhancements
  • Big-screen projections during dinner or performances—for an immersive visual and musical experience
  • Guaranteed 100% client satisfaction at every celebration

Complete Event Coverage

From weddings to corporate gatherings, DJ Chris expertly handles:

  • Indian Wedding Ceremonies — “Saag Loops,” Shehnai instrumentals, and popular Hindi film scores during meals
  • Festive Nights — Mehndi, Sangeet, Raas/Garba nights, and sari ceremonies

We also specialize in a wide variety of events including:

  • Corporate functions
  • Baby showers and birthdays
  • Class reunions, graduations, and theme parties
  • Fashion shows and holiday celebrations

Multicultural & Bilingual DJ Services

DJ Chris (also known as Bay Area Indian DJ) brings:

  • Bilingual MC capabilities in Hindi, Punjabi, Gujarati, Kannada, Pakistani, and more
  • Mobile sound systems, including seamless audio setups for Baraat and other ceremony elements
  • Performance experience across a vast area—from Silicon Valley to Southern California and even nationwide destinations

Additional Entertainment & Production Services

Elevate your event with:

  • Lighting lighting—including uplighting, LED dance floors, and cold sparklers
  • Visual enhancements like photo booths, 360° video booths, and projectors/screens
  • MC hosting: professionally guide key moments from first dances to grand entrances

Why Choose DJ Jayan / DJ Chris?

  • Over 15 years of DJ experience, including collaborations with Bollywood celebrities like Salman Khan, Rani Mukerji, and DJ Suketu
  • Extensive music library with over 67,000 tracks spanning global genres—including pop, hip-hop, jazz, Cumbia, trance, and many international styles
  • Experience performing at premiere Bay Area venues such as Auberge du Soleil, Meadowood Resort, V. Sattui Winery, Masonic Temple of Martinez, and more

Featured Performance

DJ for Miss Bharat California – Milpitas (May 28, 2026)

Indian Wedding & Event DJ Services – DJ Jivan & DJ Jayan (California Bay Area)

Specializing in Indian Wedding Music & Cultural Celebrations

Bring your event to life with vibrant, high-energy music tailored to South Asian and multicultural celebrations. Our DJ services are specially curated for Indian weddings and include a wide variety of traditional and modern genres:

Wedding Music Categories:

  • Hindi Bollywood Hits
  • Bhangra (Hardcore, Pop, Tumbi/Dhol)
  • Hindi Remixes (No English Mix-ins)
  • Garba / Raas-Dandiya (Be’ Taali & Tran Taali Styles)
  • Pakistani & Arabic (Kuwaiti, Saudi, Gulf Region Music)
  • Mehendi & Sangeet Songs
  • Baraat Procession Music
  • Vidaai Geet / Farewell Songs
  • Live or Recorded Shehnai (Multi-Instrument)
  • Gujarati, Rajasthani, Punjabi Wedding Songs

Party Favorites – Crowd-Pleasers for Every Age:

  • Macarena
  • Electric Slide
  • Cha-Cha Slide
  • Limbo Rock
  • YMCA
  • The Twist

About DJ Jivan – Expert Bollywood DJ

With over 15 years of experience, DJ Jivan has performed alongside Bollywood superstars such as Salman Khan, Shah Rukh Khan, Rani Mukherji, and Gulshan Grover. He has shared the stage with renowned artists including DJ Suketu, DJ Aqeel, Jay Sean, Stereo Nation, Dr. Zeus, H-Dhami, and Raghav.

A passionate Bollywood music lover, DJ Jivan knows how to keep the energy high and the crowd dancing all night long.
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

What DJ Jayan Offers:

  • Over 67,000+ songs including Pop, Hip-Hop, Rock, Jazz, Funk, Oldies, Soul, Country, Latin, Dance, Trance & Electronica
  • Extensive international music library: India, Mexico, UK, Korea, Ireland, Hawaii, and more
  • Professional MC services for weddings and events
  • Dance floor lighting
  • Projector & screen rental for video or slideshow presentations
  • Karaoke setup
  • Complimentary event video editing and movie keepsake creation

DJ Jayan has performed for major corporations including Google, Facebook, Apple, Symantec, and Genentech, especially for Diwali parties and South Asian celebrations.

Ready to Make Your Event Unforgettable?

Contact DJ Chris today! Call or text 1‑800‑568‑0443 for pricing, availability, or to request a customized quote for your Hindi, Indian, or multicultural celebration.

Let DJ Jayan / DJ Chris transform your special day into an unforgettable cultural celebration.

DJ for Miss Bharat California – Milpitas 5/28/2024
